tools.name: how_it_works
tools.description: What Tethered Trust is, what it covers, where its data comes from, pricing and terms.

tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: Which product categories and models are in the compatibility graph, with counts. Pass a category to list its models. Covers anything that has to fit, plug in, mount, run on or charge with something someone owns. Verified catalog (specs checked against cited manufacturer sources): computers & console

tools.name: check_cart_before_checkout
tools.description: Checks a cart at checkout. Takes the checkout session exactly as a commerce protocol returns it (a UCP checkout or an ACP CheckoutSession) or plain line items, plus what the customer already owns. Returns a decision per line item, safe_to_checkout, an action (proceed, resolve_conditions, do_not_chec

tools.name: enrich_catalog
tools.description: For retailers and marketplaces (API key required): up to 50 products per call (SKU with title, URL or GTIN) in; each product's compatibility attributes out (standards it takes and provides, numeric limits, evidence level, freshness), ready to add to a product feed or UCP catalog so agents can match

tools.name: identify_product
tools.description: Call this when the person gives a shop link, ASIN, barcode or vague product name and you need the exact model and what it's compatible with. tools.name: list_standards
tools.description: Every compatibility standard family (with reviewed values), the open formats used for new values, and the numeric limit keys. How Tethered Trust represents physical connections, dimensional fit, vehicles, software and services.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Look up one product in the Tethered Trust graph by name or model number and get its structured specs, what it accepts (mounts, battery platforms, cartridges, protocols) and what it fits. If the text could mean several models, returns them all as candidates (ambiguous: true) with ambiguous: true.

tools.name: validate_purchase_plan
tools.description: Call this before you recommend or order two or more items that have to work together or with what the person owns (a PC build or upgrade, a camera kit, a smart-home setup, a charger plus cable). Check a whole purchase before recommending or ordering it: the setup the person owns (with current config

tools.name: fix_purchase_plan
tools.description: When a plan comes back incompatible or conditional: the smallest set of changes that makes it work (swap a part for a verified one that fits everything else, add a missing cooler, hub or adapter, trim quantities that exceed slots), re-validated, with the reason for each change. tools.name: plan_upgrade
tools.description: What can be upgraded on this device and with what: memory (type, slots, maximum), storage (M.2 slots, lengths, PCIe generation), power, CPU and cooling for motherboards, graphics card and cooler clearance for PC cases, plus the parts in our graph that fit (verified first) and the manufacturer's note

tools.name: identify_from_photo
tools.description: Read the brand, model and part numbers from a photo of a label or nameplate and match them to products. Matches are returned as candidates, with what was read. The photo isn't stored.

tools.name: recheck_plan
tools.description: Re-run a saved purchase plan against today's data before ordering, and see what changed since it was issued: decisions, product records, or receipt status.

tools.name: check_batch
tools.description: Up to 25 independent compatibility checks in one call (e.g. ranking candidate products for one device). Each result has its own decision, evidence and receipt.

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Call this whenever you're about to recommend, link to or buy a part, accessory, charger, filter, cartridge, lens, battery, memory, mount or adapter for something the person already owns, or they ask "will X work with Y" / "is this compatible". Pass both exact models. Covers anything that has to fit,

tools.name: find_parts
tools.description: Call this when the person names a device or appliance they own and needs a replacement or add-on ("what filter does my fridge take", "which RAM can I add", "what battery fits my drill") before you search shops or guess. Which parts and accessories fit this model? OEM parts first, then verified alter

tools.name: check_recalls
tools.description: Call this before recommending, buying or selling anything used or secondhand, any baby or kids' product, appliance, heater, battery-powered device or vehicle, or when the person asks if something is safe or recalled. Searches US government recall notices: CPSC for consumer products (appliances, furn

tools.name: verify_page
tools.description: Call this before you tell someone a web page, site or deploy is done or working, or before relying on another agent's "it's live": we open the public page in a separate browser (desktop or mobile) and check what you list. It loads; this text is visible; this link or button leads to this address; no

tools.name: verify_mcp
tools.description: Call this before you recommend, install or rely on an MCP server, after deploying one, or when a connector seems broken: we connect as an MCP client, list its tools, check each has a usable input schema and description, confirm the tools you name exist, and optionally run one sample call on a read-o

tools.name: watch_decision
tools.description: Call this after a compatibility check or purchase plan the person will act on later (an order next week, an install, a resale): we keep watching the records it rested on, their manufacturer sources and US recall notices for 30 days. Needs only the receipt_id. Free during early access.

tools.name: decision_status
tools.description: Call this right before acting on a watched decision: still_holds, changed (a record it rested on was updated), recall_on_record (a recall notice names one of the products), or expired, with what changed and what isn't monitored.

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Will this appliance physically fit this space? Compares dimensions plus typical installation clearances and required connections (power, water, gas).

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Check a Tethered Trust receipt: is the signature ours, is it still within valid_until, and have the records behind it changed since? A valid receipt proves what we said and when; it doesn't guarantee the verdict was right.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: After a purchase, report whether it actually fit. Free, safe to call, and only the first report per check counts.
